name: ContextDB
tagline: Persistent customer memory, context continuity, and pre-action evidence checks
description: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server for AI agents. Load pinned working blocks, session notes, durable customer facts, and entity relations with get_context, update memories with lineage via remember/evolve, and gate consequential actions with slot-scoped recall_for_action (act, ask, abstain). Authenticates via OAuth 2.1 + PKCE.
